items.h: One catch in Week 7 loss
items.s: White caught one of three targets for four yards in Sunday's 35-21 loss to the Rams. White has now posted back-to-back duds, totaling one catch for four yards on five targets across the last two contests. In an offense that doesn't often to use three wide receivers on the field at once, White is pretty clearly behind both Tre Tucker and Jalen Nailor for snaps and routes. White ran just nine routes on Kirk Cousins' 48 dropbacks in Week 7.

items.h: Cody White quiet in Week 7
items.s: Cody White caught one of his three targets for four yards in the Raiders' 35-21 loss to the Los Angeles Rams in Week 7. White has offered mixed results of late, finishing with less than 10 receiving yards in four of seven contests. The wideout remains difficult to trust in all formats ahead of a Week 8 contest against the New York Jets.

items.h: Cody White Continues Deep-League Potential vs. Bills
items.s: Las Vegas Raiders wide receiver Cody White is emerging within an injury-riddled receiving corps, but is it enough to target him in Week 6 against the Buffalo Bills? Jalen Nailor (concussion) is expected to play on Sunday, and the Raiders' target share already flows mostly through tight end Brock Bowers. With Tre Tucker and pass-catching running back Ashton Jeanty also in the mix, it's unlikely White will produce enough for standard fantasy leagues. Then again, the sixth-year veteran caught two of four targets for 44 yards in last week's 45-17 loss to the New England Patriots, marking his second consecutive game with four targets. Plus, Buffalo's struggling defense is allowing 280.4 passing…

items.h: Cody White Remains a Deep-League Waiver Option
items.s: Las Vegas Raiders wide receiver Cody White has earned additional playing time amid injuries to the team's receiving corps, but his limited target volume makes him a speculative waiver addition heading into Week 6. White caught two of four targets for 44 yards in Sunday's 45-17 loss to the New England Patriots, marking his second consecutive game with four targets. He has seven receptions for 108 yards and three touchdowns through five games, with all three scores coming on his first three catches of the season. His increased involvement hasn't translated into consistent fantasy production, especially with Tre Tucker and tight ends Brock Bowers and Michael Mayer occupying significant roles…

items.h: Hauls in two passes vs. New England
items.s: White caught two of four passes for 44 yards during Sunday's 45-17 loss to the Patriots. With Jalen Nailor (concussion) inactive, White stepped into the WR2 role against New England. White's 37 offensive snaps were second-most among Raiders wide receivers behind Tre Tucker (45), and the former finished third on the team in receiving yards behind Brock Bowers (110) and Ashton Jeanty (50). White opened the regular season on the Raiders' practice squad, but with both Dont'e Thornton (ankle) and Jack Bech (forearm) on injured reserve, White was inked to the 53-man roster in late September after beating out both Dareke Young and rookie sixth-rounder Malik Benson for the WR3 role behind Tucker…

items.h: Cody White hauls in two passes in Week 5
items.s: Cody White caught 2-of-4 targets for 44 yards in the Raiders loss to the Patriots. White tied his season high in targets with four and set a new season high in receiving yardage. Fantasy managers can leave White off their radar for now.

items.h: Cleared for Sunday
items.s: White (ankle) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game at New England, ESPN's Paul Gutierrez reports. White upgraded to full participation Friday after limited practices the previous two days. With Jalen Nailor (concussion) ruled out, White has a chance to match or exceed last week's season highs for snap share (62 percent) and route share (52 percent). He caught two of four targets for 36 yards in the loss to Kansas City, after each of his first three receptions this season (in Weeks 2-3) had gone for touchdowns. White's 48 snaps on offense last week were more than he played in Weeks 1-3 combined, and it was also the first time this year he didn't have a role on special teams.…

items.h: Cody White Remains Deep-League Stash in Tough Week 5 Matchup
items.s: Las Vegas Raiders wide receiver Cody White could see more targets in Week 5, but is he worth playing against a tough New England Patriots defense? White is in line to inherit more work with fellow receiver Jalen Nailor (concussion) officially ruled out for Sunday and Jack Bech (forearm) still sidelined. Still, quarterback Kirk Cousins has preferred Brock Bowers as his top target, even passing to TE2 Michael Mayer in favor of receivers like Nailor and Tre Tucker. It doesn't help that New England has been good at defending the air game, allowing just 189.8 yards and five touchdowns through Week 4. White remains a decent deep-league stash, but the tough matchup doesn't guarantee him enough…

items.h: Still limited at practice Thursday
items.s: White (ankle) was a limited participant at practice Thursday. White was a surprise addition to the Raiders' injury report Wednesday with an ankle issue, and now his availability for Week 5 seems to be in some jeopardy. He'll probably need to manage a full practice Friday to avoid carrying an injury designation into the weekend.

items.h: Nursing ankle issue
items.s: White (ankle) was a limited participant at practice Wednesday, Anthony Galaviz of The Fresno Bee reports. It's not clear when White picked up the injury, but that he got in some activity at practice Wednesday suggests it's probably not overly serious. As long as he can upgrade to full participation Thursday or Friday, there's a solid chance he'll be able to avoid carrying an injury designation into the weekend.

items.h: White caught two of four targets for 36 yards during Sunday's 30-27 loss to Kansas City.
items.s: White failed to make it three games in a row with a touchdown, but his 36 receiving yards and four targets were new season highs for the wideout. The 27-year-old now has caught five of 10 targets for 64 yards and three touchdowns over four contests to open the 2026 campaign. White already was slotted in as the team's No. 3 wide receiver with Jack Bech (forearm) on injured reserve, but he could operate in an even more prominent role in Week 5 against New England after No. 2 option Jalen Nailor suffered a concussion Sunday.

items.h: The Raiders signed White from their practice squad to their active roster Tuesday.
items.s: White began the campaign on Las Vegas' practice squad but has already been elevated for game day the maximum three times. He's collected three catches on six targets for 28 yards, with all three receptions going for touchdowns. Jack Bech (forearm) landed on injured reserve Tuesday, and White could immediately take Bech's role as the Raiders' No. 3 wide receiver.

items.h: The Raiders elevated White from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday ahead of Sunday's game against the Saints.
items.s: The Raiders have elected to utilize White's last practice squad elevation, allowing the team to carry the wide receiver into game day for each of the first three weeks of the regular season. White caught two touchdowns on two targets for a total of 24 yards in the Raiders' Week 2 win over the Chargers, leaving a strong impression in his seven offensive snaps. The 27-year-old also provides strong value on special teams, making it likely White will be first in line for a 53-man roster spot if one were to open up.

items.h: White reverted to the Raiders' practice squad Monday, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.
items.s: White was elevated to the active roster for a second straight week and finished with 13- and 11-yard touchdown receptions in the Raiders' 26-14 victory over the Chargers on Sunday. On the heels of the two-score performance, White will likely be elevated from the practice squad again for the Raiders' Week 3 game versus the Saints.

items.h: White caught both of his targets for 24 yards and two touchdowns in the Raiders' 26-14 win over the Chargers on Sunday.
items.s: White was elevated from the practice squad Saturday for the second straight week to begin the season. He played just seven offensive snaps against Los Angeles on Sunday but made the most of his limited chances, securing 11- and 13-yard touchdowns from Kirk Cousins in the second half. White is unlikely to recreate the magic going forward, as his seven pass routes were a distant fourth among Raiders wideouts, trailing Tre Tucker, Jack Bech and Jalen Nailor at the position.

items.h: White reverted to the Raiders' practice squad Monday, per the NFL's transaction log.
items.s: White failed to catch his only target in the Raiders' 27-13 win over the Dolphins on Sunday. The wide receiver played 11 of the 68 offensive snaps for the team, but he added another 14 reps on special teams and recorded three tackles on kick coverage.

items.h: The Raiders elevated White from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday.
items.s: White is set to suit up for the Raiders because the team has three wide receivers currently on injured reserve. Dont'e Thornton (undisclosed), Justin Shorter (undisclosed) and Corey Rucker (undisclosed) all must miss at least four games, allowing White to show out as a valuable depth option for the receiving corps and special teams unit.

items.h: White signed with the Raiders' practice squad Tuesday.
items.s: White appeared in 10 regular-season games for the Seahawks in 2025 but was released by the defending Super Bowl champions Sunday after failing to make the team's 53-man roster. He'll get a fresh opportunity with Las Vegas, and he would be a candidate for an elevation to the active roster if the Raiders need a pass catcher who can also contribute on special teams.

items.h: Seattle re-signed White (groin) on Wednesday.
items.s: White appears fully recovered after having been placed on IR due to a groin injury suffered in late December. Across 10 regular-season appearances in 2025, he secured three of four targets for 90 yards and one touchdown. White will spend the offseason competing for a chance to reprise a depth role in the Seahawks' wide receiver corps.

items.h: The Seahawks moved White (groin) to injured reserve Tuesday, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.
items.s: White sustained the injury early in the first quarter of last Sunday's game against the Titans. With the move to injured reserve, White will be able to return only for a potential Super Bowl matchup, and even then, only if the Seahawks do not score the first-round bye that comes with the NFC's top seed. In corresponding moves, the team signed Amari Kight to the active roster and signed Montorie Foster to the practice squad as a potential elevation replacement for White.

items.h: White (groin) is doubtful to return to Sunday's game against the Panthers.
items.s: White appeared to sustain the injury early in the first quarter while on punt coverage. The Seahawks would be down a pivotal contributor on special teams if White is unable to return, and Dareke Young and Jake Bobo are poised to take on larger roles on offense.

items.h: White wasn't targeted in Thursday's 38-37 overtime win versus the Rams.
items.s: White logged just six offensive snaps as the team's No. 4 wide receiver. The Seahawks frequently use two tight ends or a fullback, leaving little opportunity for White to get into the mix. He'll likely continue to have a limited role in Week 17 versus the Panthers.

items.h: White (abdomen) was a full participant in Seattle's walkthrough Tuesday, Michael-Shawn Dugar of The Athletic reports.
items.s: White appears to be healthy again after being limited during Monday's walkthrough due to an abdominal injury. The 27-year-old should continue to contribute on special teams while also seeing limited snaps on offense during Thursday's matchup versus the Rams.

items.h: White (abdomen) was a limited participant in Monday's walkthrough practice, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.
items.s: White may have picked up the injury during the Seahawks' 18-16 win over the Colts on Sunday, when he did not record a target while playing nine snaps on offense. He'll have two more opportunities to increase his practice participation ahead of Thursday's NFC West tilt against the Rams.

items.h: White wasn't targeted in Sunday's 18-16 win over the Colts.
items.s: QB Sam Darnold threw the ball 36 times in this game, but White couldn't get into the rotation while playing just nine offensive snaps. The 27-year-old wide receiver has caught three passes for 90 yards and a touchdown over eight games this season.

items.h: White caught his lone target for 21 yards in Sunday's 26-0 win over the Vikings.
items.s: White recorded his first catch since Week 9 and his second of the season in the blowout win. He has totaled just 25 total snaps over the last two weeks, and his usage should remain limited as long as Jaxon Smith-Njigba, Cooper Kupp and Rashid Shaheed are healthy.

items.h: White wasn't targeted in Sunday's 30-24 win over the Titans.
items.s: Sam Darnold attempted 26 passes, and with 10 of those going towards Jaxon Smith-Njigba, it was difficult for White to get into the mix while playing just 10 offensive snaps. He'll continue to operate as the No. 4 wide receiver in the Week 13 game versus the Vikings.

items.h: White was elevated from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, Ari Horton of the Seahawks' official site reports.
items.s: White has now been elevated for a second consecutive week, meaning he has one more elevation before he will need to be signed to the active roster to suit up. The wide receiver caught one of two targets for a 60-yard touchdown in this past Sunday's win over the Commanders, and he will once again be used to fill some holes caused by injuries in the Seahawks' corps. With Cooper Kupp (hamstring) questionable, Tory Horton (groin/shin) doubtful, Jake Bobo (calf) out and Dareke Young (quadriceps) on injured reserve, White will likely have to be a meaningful contributor for the Seahawks offense…

items.h: White reverted to Seattle's practice squad Monday, per the NFL's transaction log.
items.s: White was elevated ahead of Sunday's win over Washington and made a big impact, catching one of two targets for a 60-yard touchdown. He also logged 29 yards on one kick return and was even credited with a tackle following a Sam Darnold interception. White logged 36 of Seattle's 51 offensive snaps in the contest, finishing second among the team's wideouts behind Tory Horton (37), though Jaxon Smith-Njigba (34 offensive snaps) remains the no-doubt alpha among the WR corps. Wideouts Cooper Kupp (hamstring), Jake Bobo (Achilles) and Dareke Young (quadriceps) all missed the contest, and the…

items.h: White was elevated from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.
items.s: White has played five offensive snaps and six special teams snaps to this point in 2025, and he will look to continue to accumulate playing time during the Seahawks' Week 9 matchup with the Commanders. The 26-year-old wide receiver was elevated to fill in on special teams for the injured Dareke Young and Jake Bobo, Bob Condotta of The Seattle Times reports.

items.h: The Seahawks signed White to the practice squad Friday, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.
items.s: White has been bouncing between the Seahawks' practice squad and active roster through the first six weeks of the season. He's played five offensive snaps and six on special teams to this point in 2025.

items.h: The Seahawks released White on Thursday.
items.s: White has been doing this song and dance all season, bouncing around the active roster and practice squad while also getting released in between. He's appeared in just one game in 2025, seeing five snaps on offense and another six on special teams.

items.h: White (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against Tampa Bay.
items.s: White will be a healthy scratch for a second straight week, and his next opportunity to see the field is Week 6 against the Jaguars on Sunday, Oct. 12. Jake Bobo and Dareke Young will provide depth at wide receiver while White is sidelined.

items.h: White (coach's decision) is inactive for Thursday's game against the Cardinals.
items.s: White was signed to the Seahawks' active roster Tuesday, but he'll observe Thursday's game in street clothes. His next opportunity to play will be Week 5 against Tampa Bay on Sunday, Oct. 5.

items.h: The Seahawks signed White from the practice squad to the active roster Tuesday, Bob Condotta of The Seattle Times reports.
items.s: White has bounced back and forth between the Seahawks' practice squad and active roster, and Tuesday marked the second time in a week that he was signed to the 53-man roster. He played 11 snaps (five on offense, six on special teams) in the Seahawks' Week 1 loss to the 49ers and finished with 59 kick return yards on two attempts. White could serve in a kick return role alongside George Holani or Dareke Young now that he's back on the active roster.

items.h: The Seahawks released White but signed him back to the practice squad Friday, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.
items.s: White has had a whirlwind week, as he was signed to the Seahawks' active roster Wednesday. He'll now return to the practice squad, and he is a candidate to be elevated ahead of Sunday's game against the Saints.

items.h: The Seahawks signed White off the practice squad Wednesday.
items.s: With Tory Horton dealing with a groin issue that limited him in Wednesday's practice, White finds a spot on the 53-man roster with Seattle. The 26-year-old White has appeared in 21 career regular-season games and has secured eight of 10 targets for 79 scoreless yards. He'll provide wideout depth for the Seahawks.

items.h: Seattle signed White to its practice squad Friday.
items.s: The Seahawks had to release him from their active roster Thursday to make room for cornerback Shaquill Griffin, but White is now back with the team as a member of the practice squad. Seattle is carrying only five wide receivers on its 53-man roster, so he could be on the short list for a practice-squad elevation for Week 2 and beyond.

items.h: The Seahawks released White on Thursday, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.
items.s: The veteran wideout is expected to sign with the team's practice squad. His 53-man roster spot went to Shaquill Griffin, who was signed off the practice squad Thursday. In Week 1 against San Francisco, White played five offensive snaps and another six on special teams, returning two kickoffs for 59 yards.

items.h: White (shoulder) has no injury designation ahead of Sunday's matchup against the 49ers, Brady Henderson of ESPN.com reports.
items.s: Despite White opening Seattle's week of practice with consecutive limited sessions, he'll suit up for the team's regular-season opener Sunday. The Michigan State product appeared in four games with the Seahawks last season, catching two of his three targets for 44 yards while also contributing on special teams (49 snaps). White is expected to play a similar role ahead of the 2025 season.

items.h: White (shoulder) was a limited participant in Seattle's practice Wednesday, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.
items.s: White had a strong performance during the team's final preseason game but is now in jeopardy of missing the start of the regular season. The Seahawks could find themselves shorthanded at receiver for Sunday's matchup, as Jake Bobo (concussion) and Dareke Young (hamstring) are both dealing with injuries as well.

items.h: White caught three of five targets for 69 yards and a touchdown in Saturday's 20-7 preseason loss to the Packers.
items.s: With the starters sitting out, White led all Seahawks receivers in receiving yards while scoring the team's only touchdown. The 26-year-old wideout is on the roster bubble, but his strong showing Saturday helps his cause against seventh-round rookie Ricky White.

items.h: White didn't catch either of his two targets in Thursday's 23-23 tie against the Raiders.
items.s: White started the first half with Drew Lock at quarterback but was unable to haul in a pass all game. The 26-year-old wideout played four games with the Seahawks last season and caught two passes (three targets) for 44 yards. He's on the roster bubble this season and is primarily competing with fourth-year wideout Dareke Young and rookie Ricky White.

items.h: The Seahawks re-signed White on Friday, Michael-Shawn Dugar of The Athletic reports.
items.s: White wasn't tendered by Seattle at the start of the new league year, but he'll now re-sign with the team. He appeared in four regular-season games with the Seahawks in 2024, with all of his counting stats (two grabs for 44 yards on three targets) having come Week 9 versus the Rams. He'll spend the offseason competing for a depth spot at wide receiver.

items.h: White became an unrestricted free agent Wednesday due to the Seahawks not extending a qualifying tender on his contract, Bob Condotta of The Seattle Times reports.
items.s: White entered the offseason as an exclusive rights free agent, but he'll now be free to sign with another team due to the Seahawks not tendering his contract. White initially signed to Seattle's practice squad in late August after failing to make the team's 53-man roster at the conclusion of training camp, but he was signed to the active roster in mid-November. He appeared in four regular-season games for the Seahawks in 2024, but his two catches (on three targets) for 44 yards all came against the Rams in Week 9.

items.h: White (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Rams.
items.s: White, whom Seattle signed off its practice squad in mid-November, will close the season as a healthy inactive for the fifth consecutive game. Before his recent streak of absences, the 26-year-old receiver appeared in four games for Seattle and recorded two catches for 44 yards on three targets over 59 snaps on offense.

items.h: The Seahawks signed White from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday.
items.s: White's lone elevation from the practice squad came in Week 9 against the Rams, when he caught two passes (on three targets) for 44 yards. White is unlikely to see much playing time on offense, especially with DK Metcalf returning from a two-game absence due to a knee injury, though the former could contribute on special teams.

items.h: White reverted to the Seahawks' practice squad Monday, per the NFL's official transaction log.
items.s: White was elevated for Sunday's 26-20 overtime loss to the Rams with DK Metcalf out with a knee injury, and he played on 35 of 80 offensive snaps, catching two of his three targets for 44 yards and no scores. Jaxon Smith-Njigba (71 snaps), Tyler Lockett (71 snaps) and Jake Bobo (42 snaps) all played more than White on Sunday, though the call-up did play more than Dareke Young (six snaps) and Laviska Shenault (three snaps). White also played on 11 special-teams snaps and blocked a punt.

items.h: The Seahawks elevated White from their practice squad Saturday, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.
items.s: If he's active Sunday, White will suit up for the first time since he played in one game for the Steelers in 2022. The 25-year-old spent part of last year on Seattle's practice squad but didn't get elevated at any point. White's elevation this weekend is tied to DK Metcalf being sidelined due to a knee injury.

items.h: The Seahawks signed White to the practice squad Wednesday.
items.s: White spent portions of the 2023 season on the Seahawks' practice squad, but he did not play in a single regular-season game. He finished the preseason catching four passes (on nine targets) for 74 yards, but he wasn't able to crack Seattle's 53-man roster. White will stick around on the taxi squad and stay ready for a promotion to the active roster.

items.h: White was waived by the Seahawks on Tuesday, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.
items.s: White signed with Seattle in January but was unable to earn a spot on the team's final roster. The 25-year-old will now look for a new opportunity elsewhere.

items.h: The Seahawks signed White to a reserve/future contract Monday, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.
items.s: White got into 15 games with Pittsburgh in 2021, but he's seen action in only one NFL contest since. The wideout had two stints with Seattle's practice squad in 2023 and apparently made enough of an impression for the organization to want to hang onto him through the offseason. White will get a chance to compete for a roster spot during training camp this summer.

items.h: The Seahawks signed White to their practice squad Monday, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.
items.s: A little more than a month after cutting White from its practice squad, Seattle has decided to bring him back into the fold ahead of Week 13. If 2022 seventh-rounder Dareke Young (abdomen) is unable to play in Thursday's game against the Cowboys, White could be elevated to the active roster.
